contact.lede: Tell us what you are trying to build, or what has stalled. We reply with a straight answer about whether we are the right team for it.

read.name: We read it ourselves
read.desc: No form triage and no account manager in between. The people who would build it are the people who reply.

fit.name: We say whether we fit
fit.desc: Including when we do not. If what you need is a workflow fix rather than a model, we would rather tell you than sell you.

scope.name: We scope it properly
scope.desc: A call about your data and your constraints, then a written scope with what it costs and what it does not cover.

form.name: Name
form.doneBody: We read every enquiry ourselves and reply with a straight answer.
form.error: That did not go through. Try again, or email us directly.

agents.name: AI Agents & Automation
agents.desc: Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents that run real operations: triage, research, reporting, workflow orchestration, with guardrails and audit trails built in.

rag.name: LLM Integration & RAG Systems
rag.desc: Language models grounded in your documents and data. Retrieval pipelines, evaluation harnesses and versioned prompts, not a thin wrapper around an API.

ml.name: Machine Learning Engineering
ml.desc: Models trained, served and monitored as production software: feature pipelines, drift detection, rollback paths.

data.name: Data Intelligence
data.desc: The layer AI depends on: warehouses, pipelines and decision dashboards that make your data usable before anything clever touches it.

software.name: Custom Software & SaaS
software.desc: Fifteen years of product engineering. Web platforms, internal tools and SaaS products built to outlive their launch.

cloud.name: Cloud & DevOps
cloud.desc: Infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability and cost control across AWS, Azure and GCP.

discover.name: Discover
discover.desc: We audit your data, workflows and constraints, and tell you plainly what AI can and cannot do for them.

prototype.name: Prototype
prototype.desc: A working system on your real data within weeks, measured against success criteria we agree up front.

ship.name: Ship
ship.desc: Hardening for production: evals, monitoring, access control, failure modes handled before launch day.

scale.name: Scale
scale.desc: Extend across teams and geographies. We hand over cleanly or stay on as your engineering partner.

accountable.name: One accountable team
accountable.desc: The Big Four write the strategy and hand you a deck. Integrators build what the deck says, late. We do both, and the same team answers for the result.

earnsPlace.name: AI where it earns its place
earnsPlace.desc: Most of what gets sold as AI is a workflow problem wearing a model. We will tell you when that is the case, including when it costs us the engagement.

outlive.name: Built to outlive the launch
outlive.desc: Evals, monitoring, access control and rollback paths are part of shipping, not a phase after it. The agent that impressed the board still runs a year later.

healthcare.name: Healthcare
healthcare.desc: Clinical documentation, triage support and patient correspondence, built where an audit trail and a human sign-off are not optional.

finance.name: Finance
finance.desc: Reconciliation, reporting and document review, with every model output traceable to the record it came from.

real-estate.name: Real estate
real-estate.desc: Listing intelligence, valuation support and tenant correspondence across portfolios that outgrew their spreadsheets.

retail.name: Retail & commerce
retail.desc: Catalogue enrichment, demand signals and support automation that survive a peak trading week.

education.name: Education
education.desc: Assessment support, content generation and student-facing assistants, with a clear line between help and answer.

manufacturing.name: Manufacturing
manufacturing.desc: Quality inspection, maintenance forecasting and shop-floor reporting on data that was never collected for AI.

fintech.name: Fintech
fintech.desc: Onboarding, KYC document handling and fraud signals, under the review process that regulation actually requires.

legal.name: Legal & professional
legal.desc: Contract review, discovery and precedent search, where a confident wrong answer costs more than no answer.
